review_scope: Native task inputs/restart/evaluation, bounded cohort supervisor and launcher, and all16 candidate command/config/package identities. No final-model scientific outcome is claimed.

test_evidence.backend: CPU; cloud/provider calls mocked in supervisor/launcher tests

verified: Exactly 15 visible observations after a native hit; sampled full blackout lengths obey ceil(D/2)..D at D=1,2,3,7,60.
No darkness before discovery; terminal reward clears knowledge and renews visibility.
D=0 is always visible without clock RNG draws; curriculum reaches exactly60 at200M frames and does not extend an in-progress gap.
Private clock leaves global torch, NumPy and Python RNG states unchanged and repeats duration draws across paired evaluation groups.
Clock restoration reproduces a long mixed event stream and does not alias saved clock tensors.
Pure gate zeros the full RGB/current512-cell input while preserving source tensors and visible values.
Clock and gate do not alter native dynamics, reward, render output, image/motor noise or environment RNG under the same action tape.
Matched Grid/PGC populations have identical phases/wavevectors and ordinary-cell values; de-shifting PGC equals the independent Grid code exactly.
Matched seeds initialize identical policy parameters and provide no extra velocity/heading inputs.
Online actor, recurrent replay and bootstrap use identical gates and preserve native saved goal, previous action and clipped reward semantics.
Bootstrap/replay do not advance the sensory clock or consume the first blind observation.
Terminal pickup clears goal, previous action/reward and both recurrent states before the next policy input.
Complete training restart reproduces subsequent actions/logits, losses, optimizer parameters, simulator state and all saved RNG states through native episode resets.
Restoration does not let optimizer updates mutate the saved checkpoint object.
Zero-gap collection matches an independent direct native policy/environment loop bitwise, including actions, rewards, bootstrap and environment/action RNG streams.
Behavioral evaluation preserves model weights and first-discovery pairing; Grid substitutions are exact shams; onset/every-blind-step erasure counts agree with their definitions.
After TF32default0 and Categorical(validate_args=False), the direct native-loop equivalence and complete restart tests remain exact.
Supervisor requires bound immutable instance IDs and portable output/protocol paths matching each frozen job.
The full not-yet-launched cohort reservation must fit the cumulative ledger budget before another launch.
Metric-only first-four promotion requires the expected live RUNNING VM; reward outcomes do not enter the technical gate.
Valid terminal DONE artifacts are processed before live-VM checks, including provider-deleted workers; missing remote terminal metrics fall back to collected files or halt explicitly.
Terminal completion checks actual saved checkpoint/runtime/summary frames, decision counters, provenance and model condition/seed/map-seed/gap against the job.
All16 candidate CLI configurations match the current protocol, explicitly use TF32=0, and reproduce the exact package manifest.
The launcher accepts25.5h hard provider deadlines, rejects25.51h, retains eight-worker and cumulative600USD guards, and budgets the16-worker cohort at515USD.
